title: Resident services policy
description: Which DAEMON_SPECS entries a checkout keeps registered with the host service manager (launchd / systemd --user / Task Scheduler). Consumed by `pnpm kyberion scheduler reconcile` (libs/core/daemon/resident-services.ts).

owner_surface.description: When this surface is enabled in active-surfaces.json (plus the operator overlay), surface-runtime runs the daemon and no OS unit is installed.
